From ecf81ed98c8df8c6d397f4e044af175481b5b831 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Andrzej Hajda <a.hajda@samsung.com>
Date: Tue, 8 May 2018 11:36:58 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/exynos/dsi: mask frame-done interrupt

DSI driver is not really interested in this interrupt. It causes only
unnecessary code execution of interrupt handler and could possibly
cause FIFO overflow - as it triggers DSI interrupt handler to process
next DSI transfer. With this patch we will get rid of about 30 IRQ
handler calls per second.

Fixes: e6f988a45857 ("drm/exynos: dsi: add support for Exynos5433")
Signed-off-by: Andrzej Hajda <a.hajda@samsung.com>
Signed-off-by: Inki Dae <inki.dae@samsung.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/exynos/exynos_drm_dsi.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/exynos/exynos_drm_dsi.c
index eae44fd714f0..7c3030b7e586 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/exynos/exynos_drm_dsi.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/exynos/exynos_drm_dsi.c
@@ -1264,15 +1264,15 @@ static irqreturn_t exynos_dsi_irq(int irq, void *dev_id)
 
 	if (status & DSIM_INT_SW_RST_RELEASE) {
 		u32 mask = ~(DSIM_INT_RX_DONE | DSIM_INT_SFR_FIFO_EMPTY |
-			DSIM_INT_SFR_HDR_FIFO_EMPTY | DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE |
-			DSIM_INT_RX_ECC_ERR | DSIM_INT_SW_RST_RELEASE);
+			DSIM_INT_SFR_HDR_FIFO_EMPTY | DSIM_INT_RX_ECC_ERR |
+			DSIM_INT_SW_RST_RELEASE);
 		exynos_dsi_write(dsi, DSIM_INTMSK_REG, mask);
 		complete(&dsi->completed);
 		return IRQ_HANDLED;
 	}
 
 	if (!(status & (DSIM_INT_RX_DONE | DSIM_INT_SFR_FIFO_EMPTY |
-			DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE | DSIM_INT_PLL_STABLE)))
+			DSIM_INT_PLL_STABLE)))
 		return IRQ_HANDLED;
 
 	if (exynos_dsi_transfer_finish(dsi))
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos/exynos_drm_dsi.c`**
   - The code modification involves changing the interrupt mask settings in the `exynos_dsi_irq` function.
   - The `DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE` interrupt has been removed from the mask that is written to the `DSIM_INTMSK_REG`. This means that the driver will no longer respond to the `FRAME_DONE` interrupt, which is deemed unnecessary for the DSI driver’s operation.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The removal of the `DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE` interrupt from the interrupt mask is intended to reduce unnecessary calls to the interrupt handler, which were causing performance issues such as potential FIFO overflow. By masking this interrupt, the driver will avoid processing it, leading to a more efficient handling of DSI transfers and a reduction in the number of IRQ handler calls per second. This change is directly related to the goal of improving the driver’s performance and stability.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (status & DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE) {
    ...
}
```
```c
u32 mask = ~(DSIM_INT_RX_DONE | DSIM_INT_SFR_FIFO_EMPTY |
             DSIM_INT_SFR_HDR_FIFO_EMPTY | DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE |
             DSIM_INT_RX_ECC_ERR | DSIM_INT_SW_RST_RELEASE);
```
Reason:
The DSI driver was processing the `FRAME_DONE` interrupt, which was unnecessary for its operation. This led to excessive calls to the interrupt handler every time a frame was completed, causing performance issues such as FIFO overflow due to the rapid triggering of the handler.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
u32 mask = ~(DSIM_INT_RX_DONE | DSIM_INT_SFR_FIFO_EMPTY |
             DSIM_INT_SFR_HDR_FIFO_EMPTY | 
             DSIM_INT_RX_ECC_ERR | DSIM_INT_SW_RST_RELEASE);
```
```c
if (!(status & (DSIM_INT_RX_DONE | DSIM_INT_SFR_FIFO_EMPTY |
                DSIM_INT_PLL_STABLE))) 
```
Reason:
The patch removes the `DSIM_INT_FRAME_DONE` from the interrupt mask, preventing the driver from processing this interrupt. This reduces unnecessary calls to the interrupt handler, thereby mitigating the risk of FIFO overflow and improving overall performance.
